# TXO Partners Declares a Third Quarter 2026 Distribution of $0.44 on Common Units


November 03, 2026 4:15pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_5508288275dcf28a843033162ce008be/txoenergy/news/2026-11-03_TXO_Partners_Declares_a_Third_Quarter_2026_29.pdf)


FORT WORTH, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- TXO Partners, L.P. (NYSE, NYSE Texas: TXO) announced today that the Board of Directors of its general partner declared a distribution of $0.44 per common unit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The quarterly distribution will be paid on November 20, 2026, to eligible unitholders of record as of the close of trading on November 13, 2026.


“Fundamentally, TXO prospers as a production and distribution company, driven by dynamic capital allocation,” stated Brent W. Clum, Co-Chief Executive Officer and CFO. “Within our strategy, we closely manage distributions, leverage and growth capital with a focus on long-term value. With that in mind, TXO is distributing $0.44 per unit to unitholders for our third quarter. Looking into 2027, we are designing another robust program to yield strong returns for our owners while being responsive to ever-changing market conditions.”


“Our development teams did a stellar job extending laterals in our Williston Basin wells and delivering production rates in excess of 1,000 BOE per day on average,” Gary D. Simpson, Co-Chief Executive Officer commented. “Overall, drilling times were improved with total costs on budget and our exploitation activities exceeding expectations. TXO continues to expand its outlook with years of resource development across its operating regions. With this momentum, the Company remains focused on creating value while returning capital to its owners.”


**About TXO Partners, L.P.** TXO Partners, L.P. is a master limited partnership focused on the acquisition, development, optimization and exploitation of conventional oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGL) reserves in North America. TXO’s current acreage positions are concentrated in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico, the San Juan Basin of New Mexico and Colorado and the Williston Basin of Montana and North Dakota.


**Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q** TXO's financial statements and related footnotes will be available in the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which TXO will file with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) today. The 10-Q will be available on TXO's Investor Relations website at[www.txopartners.com/investors](http://www.txopartners.com/investors) or on the SEC's website at[www.sec.gov](http://www.sec.gov/) . TXO unitholders may request a printed copy free of charge of the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q by emailingIR@txopartners.com or by writing to Investor Relations, 400 West 7th Street, Fort Worth, Texas 76102.


**Non-U.S. Withholding Information** This press release is intended to be a qualified notice under Treasury Regulations Section 1.1446-4(b). Brokers and nominees should treat one hundred percent (100%) of TXO’s distribution to foreign unitholders as being attributable to income that is effectively connected with a United States trade or business. Accordingly, TXO’s distributions to foreign unitholders are subject to federal income tax withholding at the highest applicable effective tax rate. For purposes of Treasury Regulations Section 1.1446(f)-4(c)(2)(iii), brokers and nominees should treat one hundred percent (100%) of the distributions as being in excess of cumulative net income for purposes of determining the amount to withhold. Nominees, and not TXO, are treated as withholding agents responsible for any necessary withholding on amounts received by them on behalf of foreign unitholders.
